sampling: One prespecified recipe: P(clean)=0.5; each of nine noisy conditions has probability 0.5/9. One condition per sample; resampled every epoch. Not optimized against E2-E5 test results.
selection: Highest equally weighted mean Macro-F1 over ten full validation conditions; earliest epoch wins exact ties
initialization: Random initialization using E1 initialization rule, seed 123 for every fold; no E1/E5 checkpoint loading
validation_test_noise: Exactly reuse Noise v2, seed 123 and filename:epoch IDs as implemented by E2-E5
